ext.description: Sign and verify Markdown documents with md-signature, and see what each signature covers.
ext.untrusted: In Restricted Mode, documents are verified without the network, and signing is off.
cfg.network: When verification may fetch keys, revocation lists, and resources over the network.
cfg.network.trusted: Only in trusted workspaces (documents opened in Restricted Mode are checked offline).
cfg.network.never: Never; signatures are checked offline only.
cfg.checkRevocation: Check the signer's revocation list when a signature names one (SPEC 5.9).
cfg.fetchResources: Fetch https resources listed in signatures to check their hashes (SPEC 5.7). Local files are always checked.
cfg.keyDirectories: Key directories to trust in addition to the built-in list and the ones added with `mdsig directory trust add` (SPEC 4.7).
cfg.keyserver: OpenPGP keyserver used when a key is not in the local keyring or WKD (default: keys.openpgp.org).
cfg.tsaUrl: Time-stamping authority used when signing with a timestamp.
cfg.tsaRoots: Additional TSA root certificates (PEM or DER files) to trust.
cfg.keyFile: OpenSSH Ed25519 private key file to offer first when signing.
cfg.showHidden: Show HTML comments and invisible characters in the Markdown preview (SPEC 9.5).
cfg.fullText: Show every line in the signature view instead of shortening long documents.
cfg.warnFormatters: Warn when editor settings would rewrite a signed document on save.
